mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM article WHERE repositoryId = #{repositoryId} AND (#{keyword} IS NULL OR title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) AND (#{searchItem} = 0 OR memberId = #{searchItem})

SELECT A.*, M.nickName AS extra__writer FROM article A JOIN `member` M ON A.memberId = M.id WHERE repositoryId = #{repositoryId} AND (#{keyword} IS NULL OR title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) AND (#{searchItem} = 0 OR memberId = #{searchItem}) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limitFrom}, #{itemsInAPage}
SELECT A.*, M.nickName AS extra__writer FROM article A JOIN `member` M ON A.memberId = M.id WHERE A.id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE article SET title = #{title}, body = #{body}, updateDate = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT a.*, COALESCE(r.likes, 0) AS extra__sumReaction, COALESCE(re.replies, 0) AS extra__sumReplies, m.nickName AS extra__writer, (a.hits * 0.3 + COALESCE(r.likes, 0) * 0.7) AS weighted_score, (a.hits * 0.3 + COALESCE(r.likes, 0) * 0.7) * (1 - LEAST(DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE, a.regDate), #{days}) / #{days}) AS trending_score FROM article a LEFT JOIN (SELECT relId, COUNT(*) AS likes FROM reaction WHERE relType = 'article' GROUP BY relId) r ON a.id = r.relId LEFT JOIN ( SELECT articleId, COUNT(*) AS replies FROM reply GROUP BY articleId ) re ON a.id = re.articleId LEFT JOIN member m ON a.memberId = m.id WHERE a.regDate >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL #{days} DAY) ORDER BY trending_score DESC LIMIT #{count};

SELECT a.*, m.nickName as extra__writer, m.email, COALESCE(r.likes, 0) AS extra__sumReaction, COALESCE(re.replies, 0) AS extra__sumReplies FROM article a LEFT JOIN (SELECT relId, COUNT(*) AS likes FROM reaction WHERE relType = 'article' GROUP BY relId) r ON a.id = r.relId LEFT JOIN ( SELECT articleId, COUNT(*) AS replies FROM reply GROUP BY articleId ) re ON a.id = re.articleId INNER JOIN follow f ON f.fromMemberId = a.memberId INNER JOIN member m ON a.memberId = m.id WHERE f.toMemberId = #{memberId} ORDER BY a.regDate DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM article a INNER JOIN follow f ON f.fromMemberId = a.memberId WHERE f.fromMemberId = #{memberId}

SELECT a.*, COALESCE(r.likes, 0) AS extra__sumReaction, COALESCE(re.replies, 0) AS extra__sumReplies FROM article a LEFT JOIN (SELECT relId, COUNT(*) AS likes FROM reaction WHERE relType = 'article' GROUP BY relId) r ON a.id = r.relId LEFT JOIN ( SELECT articleId, COUNT(*) AS replies FROM reply GROUP BY articleId ) re ON a.id = re.articleId WHERE a.repositoryId = #{repositoryId} ORDER BY a.regDate DESC

SELECT a.*, m.nickName AS extra__writer, m.email, COALESCE(r.likes, 0) AS extra__sumReaction, COALESCE(re.replies, 0) AS extra__sumReplies, COALESCE(h.viewCount, 0) AS hits FROM article a INNER JOIN member m ON a.memberId = m.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT relId, COUNT(*) AS likes FROM reaction WHERE relType = 'article' GROUP BY relId ) r ON a.id = r.relId LEFT JOIN ( SELECT articleId, COUNT(*) AS replies FROM reply GROUP BY articleId ) re ON a.id = re.articleId LEFT JOIN ( SELECT articleId, COUNT(*) AS viewCount FROM hits GROUP BY articleId ) h ON a.id = h.articleId WHERE a.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.body LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.nickName LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY a.regDate DESC
